manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Rescue the Foal by paying {1}{W}, blinking Abdel Adrian and exiling Rescue the Foal.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enters-the-battlefield abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.
